+

 > [!IMPORTANT]
-> After you enable this capability, your Arc-enabled machine will be Microsoft Entra joined. This scenario is for machines that are planned to not be joined to another domain, like on-premises Active Directory or Microsoft Entra Domain Services. If you need to do so, disconnect the device from Microsoft Entra by uninstalling the extension and instead use the [Entra hybrid join](./concept-hybrid-join.md) solution. If you need to do so, disconnect the device from Microsoft Entra by uninstalling the extension and instead use the [Entra hybrid join](./concept-hybrid-join.md) solution. modifiedFiles.commitMessage: Update Microsoft Entra join details in Arc sign-in guide

englishSummary.headline: Arc sign-in guide updates Microsoft Entra join guidance
englishSummary.summary: The guide was revised to state that enabling the capability Microsoft Entra joins the Arc-enabled machine and is intended for machines not planned to join another domain, such as on-premises Active Directory or Microsoft Entra Domain Services.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Review the guidance before enabling Arc sign-in and verify the target machine’s domain-join scenario.

@@ -28,7 +28,7 @@ There are many security benefits of using Microsoft Entra ID-based authenticatio
 MDM autoenrollment requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 licenses. Windows Server VMs don't support MDM enrollment.
 
 > [!IMPORTANT]
-> After you enable this capability, your Azure virtual machine will be Microsoft Entra joined. You can't join them to another domain, like on-premises Active Directory or Microsoft Entra Domain Services. If you need to do so, disconnect the device from Microsoft Entra by uninstalling the extension. In addition, if you deploy a supported golden image, you can enable Microsoft Entra ID authentication by installing the extension. Conditional Access isn't supported with Windows Server with Microsoft Entra join extension in Azure Windows virtual machines.
+> After you enable this capability, your Azure virtual machine will be Microsoft Entra joined. If you are using Entra Connect V2, you do not need to also use the Entra extension. If you install the extension on a workgroup machine and would then like to join a domain instead, like on-premises Active Directory or Microsoft Entra Domain Services, disconnect the device from Microsoft Entra by uninstalling the extension. Device configuration details as part of Conditional Access policy for Entra are not available for Windows Server operating systems.
 
 ## Requirements
modifiedFiles.commitMessage: Update Azure VM sign-in instructions for Microsoft Entra

englishSummary.headline: Azure VM sign-in guidance updated for Entra Connect V2
englishSummary.summary: The documentation now states that Entra Connect V2 users do not also need the Entra extension. It also explains the domain-join scenario when the extension is installed on a workgroup machine.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Administrators can review their VM sign-in setup and avoid installing the extension when using Entra Connect V2.
